source_method: Image generation produced the authored geography source; EVAVO deterministic build performs registration, seam finishing, palette preservation and runtime export.

rules: Recognizable geography never repeats at the former 720-pixel plate interval.
Animated water and atmosphere never bake into the geography chunks.
Finite structures use mission-seeded slots and a different cycle from geography.
All adjacent chunk boundaries share a zero-error scanline contract derived from the two local natural edges.
No broad shared connector or blurred horizontal strip may be stamped across the chunk interiors.
